podcast.body: "Butter Boy" was Fanny's most successful single, released in 1974 on their album "Rock and Roll Survivors." The track was reportedly written about David Bowie, who was a known admirer of the band and had sent them a fan letter, often praising them in interviews. "This track was written about David Bowie, who sent them a very nice fan letter and talked about how great Fanny was whenever he was interviewed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
